industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, because the industry is split by the rotation itself: the AI capital-spending theme flipped from leadership to liability this week (Garran, MacroStrategy, 20-Nov; Mark Wilson, Goldman, 20-Nov; Menon, Jefferies, 26-Nov; surplus evidence in GPU rental prices cut by a third, halted shipments and banks selling AI loans), while Goldman's Jaisson (20-Nov) favours Technology among Cyclicals and Morgan Stanley (23-Nov) keeps Adyen Overweight. Relative strength D (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; B prior). The sector rows carry the view: Semiconductors D, Hardware D (from C this week), Software B2B Enterprise C, Fintech D. Counter-case for D: the industry is the epicentre of the correction; for B: Menon says early estimate cuts bring the semiconductor bottom forward and equipment re-rates first. To D on a hyperscaler guide cut read in the sources.

sector.why: Neutral, carried. Vertical market software is proven and lower-multiple; relative strength B (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; F prior); Pool name Chapters (leaving the Pool). No tilt.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
